title: Terms and conditions – ‘HHI Online Culinary Program Giveaway’
excerpt: Terms and conditions – ‘HHI Online Culinary Program Giveaway’
content:
Terms and conditions – ‘HHI Online Culinary Program Giveaway’ 

  1. No purchase necessary.
  2. The promotion is open to all individuals except Hippocrates employees, void in countries where prohibited.
  3. In order to be eligible for the ‘HHI Online Culinary Program’, you must fully complete the survey at one of these locations:
  4. Study 1: https://vpb73dq1.optimalworkshop.com/treejack/4e30738a
    Study 2: https://vpb73dq1.optimalworkshop.com/treejack/4e30738a-1
  5. One survey participant will be selected at random after the survey cycle has ended to receive the 'HHI Online Culinary Program'.
  6. Winning survey participant will be contacted by email provided at the conclusion of their survey. 
  7. No cash alternative will be offered.
  8. Promotion may be withdrawn at any time, without prior notice.
